The HWPX inventory report generation succeeded by correctly parsing XML structures within the zipped HWPX format and mapping them to the required schema.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without errors. Success relied on accurately navigating the HWPX container to extract document metadata, but future iterations should verify handling of malformed XML or missing 'Contents/content.hpf' files. The solution is reusable for HWPX automation tasks provided the internal directory structure remains consistent with the Hancom Office specification.
